The author behind the playbooks

Timothy Madu

Timothy Madu is a business owner, entrepreneur and author based in Yenagoa, Bayelsa State, Nigeria. He owns KC TIMO AUTOMOBILES. His Business Playbook Series focuses on practical questions about customer experience, revenue opportunities and business improvement.

A considered approach

Clarity before action.
Evidence before claims.

Practical thinking means looking closely, asking useful questions and checking what a change achieves.

01 / UNDERSTAND

See the problem clearly.

Describe the experience or opportunity before choosing a solution.

02 / DECIDE

Focus your effort.

Consider evidence, feasibility, cost and the people affected.

03 / LEARN

Check the result.

Distinguish a promising estimate from a verified improvement.
